wt.title: ⚡ React Native Snippets
wt.description: Snippets for React Native and Expo — and your AI following the same templates.
wt.welcome.title: 👋 Welcome to React Native Snippets
wt.welcome.description: Type a short prefix, press Tab, and get the React Native code you write every day. Your AI assistant can follow the same templates too.
wt.welcome.alt: React Native Snippets: an rn-ctx snippet expanded into an AuthContext
wt.snippets.title: ⌨️ Type a prefix, press Tab
wt.snippets.description:
In any .tsx, .ts, .jsx or .js file, type rn, rn-props, rn-s, rn-sc, ust or uef and press Tab.
[Try it now](command:rnSnippets.tryIt)
wt.snippets.alt: Grid of snippet prefixes: rn, rn-props, rn-s, rn-sc, ust, uef, fn, cl
wt.boilerplate.title: 🧩 FlatList, Props and Context in seconds
wt.boilerplate.description:
rn-fl, rn-props and rn-ctx write the boilerplate. Press Tab to jump between fields; in rn-ctx the name you type fills in everywhere.
[Try it now](command:rnSnippets.tryIt)
wt.boilerplate.alt: A FlatList and a component with typed Props generated by snippets
wt.aiRules.title: 🤖 Make your AI follow the same templates
wt.aiRules.description:
Write instruction files that Copilot, Cursor and Claude Code read. Existing files keep their content. You can keep them on this machine only.
[Add AI rules](command:rnSnippets.addAiRules)
wt.aiRules.alt: Project tree with AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, a Cursor rule and Copilot instructions
wt.copilot.title: 💬 Copilot fetches the templates
wt.copilot.description:
Copilot gets the templates through built-in tools, enabled by default with no setup. Using Cursor or Claude Code? Copy the one-line MCP setup.
[Open Chat](command:workbench.action.chat.open)
[Copy MCP setup](command:rnSnippets.copyMcpConfig)
wt.copilot.alt: Copilot chat calling list_snippets and get_snippet and generating an AuthProvider
wt.rate.title: ⭐ Enjoying it? Leave a star
wt.rate.description:
A rating or a star helps other React Native developers find the extension.
[Rate on the Marketplace](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=fabianocs.rn-shortcut&ssr=false#review-details)
[Star on GitHub](https://github.com/fabianocsouza/rn-shortcut)
wt.rate.alt: Five stars next to the React Native Snippets icon
tool.list.userDescription: Lists the React Native Snippets templates (components, FlatList, Context, hooks).
